Average
Aug 2026 • Couples
Another very average restaurant recommended by the famous backpacker guide. A fun setting (large warehouse converted with beautiful heavy wooden tables), frequented by many tourists, mainly Westerners (like everything else in the city), service is brisk but efficient, so why not? Except that the cuisine, advertised as simple but tasty, popular but gourmet, has practically no flavor. We had the "famous" spit-roasted duck, which disappointed us and seemed more poached than roasted (and yet it is, the rotisserie in action at the entrance proves it).
